note: parse_time converts to 24-hour time only when am/pm is written, so "3:30 in the afternoon" parses to 03:30; resolve_appt then finds none of the patient's appointments at that time and not_yours() refuses their own appointment. Recorded behavior, ruled in clinicbench docs/shakedown-report.md ("The driver reads \"3:30 in the afternoon\" as 3:30 am"; the agent's side, not defects; what the bench is for), frozen with the driver. Distinct from seeded case S05 (noon-hour pm, also parse_time, on baseline s05): T20's probes say no am/pm and avoid the noon hour; they fail on head and on s05 alike, and a parse_time that reads "in the afternoon" leaves S05's probes passing on head.
